summary: Skip feature we are not building
why: This local build keeps that feature out so the browser stays aligned with the workspace's goals.

summary: Add macOS audio output UID switch
why: Allows this Chromium build to route browser audio to a selected CoreAudio output device while falling back to the normal authorized/default device when unavailable.

summary: Add macOS tab audio output menu
why: Adds a macOS-only Send Audio To submenu to the tab context menu, enumerates CoreAudio output devices at runtime, stores explicit selections per WebContents, and asks the selected tab's media session to switch active media output.
